dcV2PolicyFiling: The kitchen can report damage or extra cleaning within 72 hours of your departure, or the booked end if no departure is recorded. Each cost needs a receipt, invoice or quote. In-app claims are capped at $250. No fines or lost revenue can be claimed. Local Cooks helps with larger amounts.
dcV2PolicyReview: Local Cooks reviews every claim before contacting the chef and updates the kitchen within 2 business days. We may ask the kitchen for more information, close the claim or pay the kitchen at no cost to the chef. Only approved claims are sent to the chef.
dcV2PolicyPayment: The chef has 72 hours to pay with a saved or new card, or dispute with a note and optional photos. Disputes and unanswered claims return to Local Cooks for a final decision. Your card is never charged automatically for a claim. The kitchen receives the approved amount; Local Cooks covers processing fees. The claim does not hold the booking payout.
dcV2PolicyHold: If an upheld claim is still unpaid 7 days after the final decision, new bookings are paused until payment or resolution with Local Cooks. Existing bookings are unaffected. The pause ends on payment, rejection, write-off or an admin release. Local Cooks can withdraw a claim at no cost to either person.

dcV2LegacySupport: Local Cooks will help with this earlier claim.
dcV2FixedRules: The pilot uses a fixed $250 cap, a 72-hour reporting window and a 72-hour chef response window. Local Cooks reviews every claim first.
dcV2ManagerQueueIntro: Report from the affected booking or inspection page. Local Cooks reviews the evidence before contacting the chef.

dcV2ManagerPolicySummary: Report damage or extra cleaning within 72 hours of the chef's departure, with a receipt for each cost (up to $250). Local Cooks reviews every claim before the chef is asked to pay.
dcV2ManagerPolicyDetails: If no departure is recorded, the 72 hours start at the booked end. Attach a receipt, invoice or quote for each cost; fines and lost revenue are excluded. Local Cooks may ask you for more evidence, reduce the amount or close the report. The chef has 72 hours to pay or dispute an approved claim; unanswered or disputed claims return to Local Cooks. The chef's card is never charged automatically. You receive the approved amount, with processing fees covered by Local Cooks. Claims do not hold your booking payout.
